recorded.prompt:q-element: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-element: "add_element(index, expressions, target)" means target = expressions[index]. Example: add_element(method[j], w, weeks[j]).
recorded.prompt:q-split: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-split: "the split tables let the contractor do P011 mechanically at the own crew's $75k". The same happens here: contractor mechanical at the own crew's $40k.
recorded.prompt:q-flat: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-flat: "With n places the multiplier is n, the length of a row". The entry is n·p + q, with p the place left: 6a + b.

recorded.prompt:q-element:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-element:a: The signature puts the index first and the target last. This option swaps them.
recorded.prompt:q-element:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-element:b: "the expressions' values form one of the tuples". Here the table only constrains m (to 5, 3 or 2, which it cannot take) and never ties weeks.
recorded.prompt:q-element:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-element:d: "add_max_equality(target, exprs) | target = the largest of the expressions". That sets weeks to 5 whatever m is.
recorded.prompt:q-split:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-split:a: "each pair is still right on its own". The (method, who) table still excludes aerial by the own crew.
recorded.prompt:q-split:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-split:b: "each pair is still right on its own". The (method, who) table excludes manual by the contractor ("no climbers").

recorded.outcome:q-split:c: "each pair is still right on its own". The (method, cost) table pairs manual only with $30k.

recorded.outcome:q-flat:b: "The order matters: 5 a_{c,w+1} + a_{c,w} reads T[q][p], the move the other way"
recorded.prompt:q-flat:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-flat:c: "With n places the multiplier is n". With 6 places it is 6, not 5.
